name: Liferun
verdict: Liferun had a strong 7-day turnaround, with leads doubling (+100%) while CPL dropped 58.27%, suggesting Meta's 647 clicks are converting efficiently after recent optimizations. Google Ads remains a concern, spending $2,048.61 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions, and the top campaign "BWS - Search Campaign - Calls" alone consumed $1,409.34 with no tracked output.

performance.verdict: Meta CPL breakthrough is real, but Google's $2,049 spend with zero conversions is the crisis.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $2,048.61 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions; top campaign 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' alone burned $1,409.34 with no tracked output.
Meta CPL collapsed 58.27% week-over-week; 94 leads in 28 days at $8.79/lead (Meta-only spend $825.99), with 3-day leads Aug 2–4 showing 15 on Aug 4 alone — uptrend confirmed.
GHL shows 103 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — 94 leads arriving with zero pipeline progression is an intake/intake-routing leak, not an ads problem.
3 SOW milestones overdue: Stripe QA (Jul 20), GHL build complete (Jul 31), GBP item opened (Jul 15) — all CRM/Web deliverables with no confirmed completion event recorded.
GA4 sessions trending down — last 3 days averaged 21.7 vs prior 3-day average of 31.3, a 30.7% drop — while Meta spend and leads are rising, suggesting landing page or tracking disconnect.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads call conversion tracking on 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls'; $1,409.34 spent with 0 conversions signals broken pixel, not zero calls.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $2,048.61 over 28 days — $1,409.34 in the BWS Search Campaign alone — with 0 recorded conversions. The client is a call-focused leadgen business; zero conversions almost certainly means the call conversion action is broken or misconfigured, not that calls aren't happening. Pull the Google Ads conversion tag audit and confirm the call extension or website call tracking fires on a live test call. Success is confirmed when at least one conversion registers in the Google Ads UI within 48 hours of the fix — target by 2026-08-07.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +20% (~$18/day increase from ~$92/day) to press the confirmed CPL drop of 58.27% and Aug 4 lead spike of 15.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 94 leads over 28 days at an effective $8.79/lead, with CPL falling 58.27% week-over-week and 15 leads recorded on Aug 4 alone. This is a confirmed efficiency win. Raise the Meta daily budget by approximately $18/day (20% of the current ~$92/day run rate). Success check: CPL remains below $20 and lead volume holds above 8/day over the next 3 days. Re-evaluate on 2026-08-08.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL pipeline intake leak: 103 opportunities created, 0 appointments, 0 won — assign Nacer to audit lead routing and follow-up automation immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 103 opportunities created against 94 leads, but 0 appointments booked and 0 deals won — leads are entering the system and stalling completely. This is not an ads problem; it is a CRM routing or follow-up automation failure. Nacer (Ops) should audit the post-lead-capture automation sequence and confirm the first follow-up step (call or SMS) is triggering within 5 minutes of contact creation. Additionally, the three overdue SOW milestones (Stripe QA Jul 20, GHL build Jul 31, GBP item Jul 15) must be confirmed complete or re-scoped. Success is at least one confirmed appointment booked through the automated flow by 2026-08-10.
